subject: history
concept: Understanding the shift from hunting/gathering to farming as a major change in early human life
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student compares a hunter-gatherer scene to a farming scene and lists differences in daily life
exercise.pictorial: Student sequences pictures showing the shift from gathering wild food to planting crops
exercise.abstract: Student explains one way farming changed how early people lived

misconception_flags: believes farming and hunting/gathering happened in reverse order or simultaneously with no real shift

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
